findings: onSuccess holds callbackLock while Req.trackRequestResult parses the response InputStream. If headers arrive but the response body stalls while updates remain queued, reportStall detects the stall but blocks on that lock until the body read or transport timeout completes. Move blocking parsing outside the lock, then recheck stalled state at the accounting boundary; also examine shouldRetry's possible ZooKeeper call under the lock. Add a controlled bounded headers-then-stalled-body regression.

The monitor regression uses null body and direct synthetic callbacks; it does not expose this scenario or prove actual runner/flush behavior. Atomic drain has no permanent controlled interleaving regression and retry is asserted by checkRetry counts rather than observed sends.
The prior same-client-monitor deadlock and finish-first test sequencing are addressed by inspection only. Queued writes remain active after fence and recovery safety remains unverified.
